required_inputs_reviewed.finding: Participation is a return-pass loop: synchronize, reread changed inputs, inspect Issues and pull requests, validate sources, update the package and rerun preflight.
Keep the proposal directory authoritative, separate facts from assumptions, preserve professional and public-interest boundaries, and validate before handoff.
The open call welcomes continuing, reviewable proposals; repository intake is not award selection, implementation approval or government endorsement.
The six agent tasks require a complete, spatially explicit, transferable and publicly compliant design package.
Source status and allowed use remain explicit; registered background material cannot replace primary evidence or official geometry.
Formal package structure, language metadata, evidence references and local gates remain binding for every return pass.

external_publication.review_draft_en: Jing-Zhang Proofline v1.6 derives One Component, One Proof-Mile from its own track, station and mile grammar. An ordinary-service base, reversible test pocket and public evidence rail form each construction bay.
